data.rationale: _sshape_validate_buffer calls _sshape_validate_buffer_item twice and needs its boolean return guarantee to verify our own postcondition and call-site preconditions.

sshape_sphere_sizes needs to know the exact value returned by _sshape_sphere_num_indices to establish its postcondition about res.indices.num. The current published spec only covers edge cases (slices==0, stacks==1) which don't apply when slices >= 3 and stacks >= 2.

data.message: My published spec already includes the equivalent postcondition: `ensures \result == (_Bool)0 || \result == (_Bool)1;`. This guarantees the function returns either false (0) or true (1), which is the boolean return guarantee requested.

Published postcondition: ensures (stacks >= 1 && 6 * slices * stacks <= 0xFFFFFFFF) ==> \result == 6 * slices * (stacks - 1); This provides the exact return value formula when the non-overflow condition holds. For typical geometry inputs (slices >= 3, stacks >= 2 with reasonable values), the caller can establish the guard condition to use this postcondition.
